cards.title: Pediatrician: Human Connection Matters More Than AI
cards.body: Loss of human connection poses a bigger threat to children's wellbeing than technology exposure. The solution lies in open conversations and quality time together, not screen time restrictions.

cards.title: Making Halloween Magic for Your Kids
cards.body: Autumn celebrations connect families through traditions spanning centuries, from Samhain to Day of the Dead. Creating Halloween moments with children builds magical memories and strengthens bonds.

cards.title: When Your Child Wants to Know About Their Donor
cards.body: Children conceived through donor conception deserve parents interested in them as unique individuals. Your anxieties about donor conception belong to you, not your child.

cards.title: Free-Range Parenting Raises Legal Questions
cards.body: A mother's conviction for allowing unsupervised play has reignited debate about childhood autonomy and parental responsibility. The case highlights tensions between safety concerns and developmental needs.

cards.title: Twin Identity: Growing Up and Growing Apart
cards.body: Twins must learn not to automatically share everything as they develop individual identities. Respecting personal boundaries and autonomy is crucial for healthy twin relationships.

cards.title: Is Your Adult Child in Crisis or Are You Anxious?
cards.body: Anxious parents of struggling adult children should pause before intervening. Distinguishing between genuine crises and parental anxiety is key to healthy adult relationships.

cards.title: Postcode Lottery Driving Children's Inequality
cards.body: A landmark report warns that children's outcomes across England are severely affected by geographic location. The commissioner calls for urgent action to close widening inequality gaps.

cards.title: Youth Employment Crisis Branded 'Moral Failure'
cards.body: One million young people in the UK are not in work or training, creating an economic and social crisis. Leaders warn this represents a critical failure to support young people's futures.
